decision.observation: The white object IS an Oxygen Diffuser blueprint: 'OXYGEN DIFFUSER (COPPER ORE) — Insufficient Resources — Copper Ore: 29.5 kg, Resources Low'. So the blueprint already consumed the mined ore and only needs ~30 kg more copper ore to finish. Ada is suffocating on the platform.
decision.hypothesis: Mining a little more copper ore (one tile yields ~340 kg) will complete the diffuser and start oxygen production. Copper ore tiles should exist in the unmined brown rock to the lower-right of the ladder base.
decision.memory: Diffuser blueprint placed right of pod at (985,340); short by 29.5 kg Copper Ore. Need to find and dig another copper ore tile.
